insurer_name: Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Maternity benefit kicks in after 3 years of continuous coverage. Pre-existing disease waiting only 24 months (low).

ayush_coverage.limit_text: In-patient or Day Care AYUSH up to Sum Insured

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Rs 50,000 (SI <=50L), Rs 1,00,000 (SI 75L-3Cr) per policy; girl child Rs 60,000-1,20,000

newborn_coverage.limit_text: First Year Vaccinations up to Rs 10,000 (boy) or Rs 15,000 (girl) - lifetime limit

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs 5,000 (SI <=50L); Rs 7,500 (75L); Rs 10,000 (1Cr); Rs 20,000 (2Cr); Rs 30,000 (3Cr) per hospitalization
ambulance_cover.notes: Plus Emergency Air Ambulance over and above Sum Insured.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Restore Benefit - once during Policy Year

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health Check-up over and above Sum Insured

disease_wise_sub_limits.first_year_vaccinations: Rs 10,000 boy / Rs 15,000 girl per child lifetime
disease_wise_sub_limits.hearing_aid: 50% of actual or Rs 10,000 per policy whichever lower (over and above SI)
disease_wise_sub_limits.daily_cash_shared_accom_or_child_accompa: 0.25% of base SI, max Rs 2,000/day (over and above SI)
disease_wise_sub_limits.prolonged_hospitalisation: 1% of Sum Insured (over and above SI)
disease_wise_sub_limits.accidental_death_benefit: 100% of base SI, max Rs 50L (over and above SI)

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Global Cover for Planned Hospitalisation (per Schedule)

permanent_exclusions: Rest cure, rehabilitation, respite care (Code Excl 05)
notable_exclusions_summary: Premium indemnity+benefit hybrid with global cover. Low PED waiting (24 months) and full Maternity, OPD, vaccinations, and prolonged hospitalisation features. Standard IRDAI permanent exclusions.
claim_process_summary: Cashless: notify 48 hrs pre-planned or 24 hrs post-emergency. Reimbursement: intimate within 7 days, submit docs within 15 days. 24x7 support 022 6489 8282.
